intro:
Angels Infant and Junior School offers boarding for Grade 1 to Grade 7 pupils in Hatcliffe, Harare.

Our boarders enjoy safe hostels, balanced meals, supervised prep, sports, and caring matrons 24/7. Ideal for parents who work far or want a focused learning environment for their child.
